notes:
Account notes / call excerpts:
- Company: developer platform building an IDE-first copilot (VS Code + JetBrains). Heavy emphasis on low-latency streaming and predictable cost per dev.
- Primary ask: TTFT (time-to-first-token) targets <= 50-80ms for single-line completions on dedicated region; sustained streaming latency under 100ms; jitter budget < 10ms for keystroke-driven completions.
- Behavioural expectations: backpressure must be graceful — when model lags, front-end expects a smooth degrade (partial stubbed suggestions) rather than stutter. Prefers prefix prefetch + incremental token streaming.
- Token budgeting: want per-session token caps + soft thresholds that trigger shorter completions. Typical session budget target: 2k tokens/session (configurable per team). Interested in Optimize suggestions to set batching/quant config per workload.
- Model/version pinning: deterministic completions are high priority for enterprise customers; need ability to pin exact model + revision and fallback chain (pinned -> compat-quantized -> smaller variant). Request rollout controls (canary, abort).
- Routing/fallback: route to Dedicated for paid teams, fallback to Hosted API smaller variant under capacity. Need observability on token usage per route and per developer.
- Security/Compliance: will require VPC or on-prem for closed-source customers, enterprise SSO + SCIM, KMS integration for key isolation, audit logs retention 1y, and contract language for code retention zero-default.
- Perf experiments we plan in POC: measure TTFT at 5th, 50th, 95th percentile; quantify jitter (ms per token) across 1000 interactive sessions; evaluate backpressure strategies: client-side queue + server-sent events vs websocket multiplexing; test KV cache warmup for repeated completions.
- Quote from lead engineer: "We need completions that feel instant — even small jitter kills muscle memory. If first token is slow, adoption drops."
- Drive/Artifacts: shared latency spec sheet (drive:/Nebula/Latency_POC_Specs.xlsx), sample telemetry dashboard mock (link in drive).
- Open asks for Redwood: provide expected TTFT numbers per model variant on g4/g5 equivalence, recommended token budget heuristics for completion vs chat, and a sample Dedicated pricing scenario for 1500 MAUs with bursts.
- Next: finalize measurement plan (metrics + dashboards), security questionnaire answers due, schedule on-prem deployment feasibility call.
